title: Hefei Institutes of Physical Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences
content: Aerogel Research Institute. Hefei Institutes of Physical Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences, is a large research organization spanning advanced materials, physics, and engineering. Its official aerogel-related work highlights heat resistance, mechanical strength, and insulation performance, supporting aerogel development and performance assessment.
